explanation: API lemma: any admissible L bounds h(n). Immediate from sInf, correct, and proved. h(n) is the least L such that every interval (m, m+L) with m ≥ 1 contains distinct a_i divisible by the i-th prime for each i ≤ π(n) (HasPrimeMultiples, 0-indexed primes). Such an L exists, so sInf is the minimum; this matches erdosproblems.com/860.
